description: Defines data models and enums for calendar events, leaves, and astrology details in the application.

classes.name: EventType
classes.description: Enumeration of different types of calendar events such as holidays, leaves, and reminders.

classes.name: LeaveType
classes.description: Enumeration of different types of leaves such as personal, sick, and casual.

classes.name: CalendarEvent
classes.description: Data class representing a calendar event with details such as id, date, title, type, and optional description.

classes.name: Leave
classes.description: Data class representing a leave entry with details such as id, date, title, type, and optional description.

classes.name: AstrologyDetails
classes.description: Data class capturing astrology-related information such as raasi, nakshatra, sunrise, sunset, and special notes.
